title: YoSQL statement front matter
description: The YAML written in SQL comments above a statement. Generated from YoSQL 2023.2.22.

annotations.description: The additional annotations to be placed on generated methods.

catchAndRethrow.description: Catch exceptions during SQL execution and re-throw them as RuntimeExceptions

createConnection.description: Controls whether the generated code should create/open connection itself or use a given connection.

description.description: The description for the SQL statement

executeBatch.description: Generate methods that are executed as batch

executeOnce.description: Generate methods that are executed once with the given parameters

generateConnectionOverloads.description: Generate both a DataSource-based method and a Connection-taking overload for every statement.

generateResultRowType.description: Write the record this statement builds its rows into.

name.description: The name of the SQL statement

parameters.description: The parameters of the SQL statement.

repository.description: The fully qualified name of the target repository class.

resultRowColumns.description: Overrides which column a component of the result row type reads

resultRowConverter.description: The fully-qualified name of the converter class to use

resultRowType.description: The fully-qualified name of a record to build each result row into

returning.description: The returning mode of the SQL statement.

throwOnMultipleResults.description: Throw an exception in case a statement using `ReturningMode.SINGLE` produces more than 1 result.

type.description: The type of the SQL statement.

validateSchema.description: Whether this statement is checked against the schema.

vendor.description: The vendor name of the database the SQL statement is intended for

writesReturnUpdateCount.description: Writing method which are using `ReturningMode.NONE` return the number of affected rows instead.
